from typing import List, Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """Record of a single document's title and its assigned cause of action."""
    document_title: str = Field(..., description="The title of the judgment document as it appears in the input")
    cause_of_action: Literal[
        "破环社会主义市场经济秩序罪",
        "执行案由-刑事",
        "行政行为-行政登记",
        "行政行为-行政给付",
        "合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷",
        "所有权纠纷",
        "行政行为-行政受理"
    ] = Field(..., description="The specific cause of action category this document belongs to")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentClassification]
